title: Quest. 53. Must the Pastor first Call the Church, and aggregate them to himself, or the Church first Congregate themselves, and then choose the Pastor?

segments.text: Answ. THe Pastors are in order of Nature, if not in time, first Ministers of Christ in general, before they are related to a particular Charge.
2. As such Ministers they first make men fit to be congregate, and tell them their duty therein.

3. But it is a matter variable and indifferent, Whether the Minister first say, [All that will joyn with me, and submit to me as their Pastor, shall be my particular Charge]: Or the people before Congregated do call a man to be their Pastor.
